title: Onboard aurora-xt-13b v2.0: performance profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Marina Patel
description: Summary: Add aurora-xt-13b v2.0 to the model registry with canonical metadata, validated performance profiles (fp16 and int8), and automated changelog/release-notes wiring. Motivation: customers on Dedicated have requested aurora-xt improvements; v2.0 includes an optimized attention kernel and tokenizer fixes that materially change perf and memory characteristics. This PR registers the model, uploads validated perf profiles from lab runs, updates docs, and wires the model metadata into the changelog automation so release notes are generated automatically for future onboardings. Changes include: model manifest (manifest.yml) with canonical fields (version, format, weights_sha256, tokenizer, quantization_support), perf profiles (perf_profiles.json) for fp16 and int8 with representative throughput/latency/cost numbers and test harness references, integration with our changelog generator (scripts/changelog/generate_changelog.py) to pick up new model metadata and emit release note snippets, docs page (docs/models/aurora-xt-13b.md) with example SDK calls and caveats, and CI tests for manifest parsing and perf-profile schema. Checklist: - [x] Add manifest and metadata - [x] Add perf profiles and test vectors - [x] Add changelog mapping and generator unit test - [x] Update docs and release notes template - [x] Add CI gating for model-registry changes Testing: unit tests (manifest schema), integration test that loads perf profile and validates numeric ranges, perf-smoke that runs the lab harness against a pinned commit of the runtime. Observability: added model tags for rollout and perf-monitoring. Rollout: merged to main; model will be visible in the registry UI after the model artifacts publish job completes and will be available for onboarding to Dedicated/private clusters. Related: Linear ENG-1452, PM-602.
